terms.title: Terms of Service (General Members)
terms.fullContent:
Article 1 (Purpose)

These Terms and Conditions aim to regulate the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between Yeowubie Interaction Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") and users in using internet-related services (hereinafter referred to as "Services") provided by the Winnie Platform (hereinafter referred to as "Platform") operated by the Company.

※ These Terms and Conditions shall also apply to e-commerce using PC communication, wireless, etc., unless contrary to its nature.

Article 2 (Definitions)

① "Platform" refers to a virtual business place set up by the Company using information and communication facilities such as computers to provide services to users, and also refers to the business operator operating the "Platform."

② "User" refers to general members (hereinafter referred to as "Members") who access the "Platform" and use the services provided by the "Platform" in accordance with these Terms.

③ "Member" refers to a person who has registered as a general member on the "Platform" and can continuously use the free services for general members provided by the "Platform."

④ Vendor members (hereinafter referred to as "Vendors") are distinguished from "Members" (general members) and refer to organizations and individuals registered on the "Platform" who use paid vendor member services such as marketing and customer management.

Article 3 (Specification, Explanation, and Amendment of Terms)

① The "Platform" shall post this Terms and Conditions, company name and representative's name, business location address, phone number, fax number, email address, business registration number, mail-order business registration number, personal information manager, etc. on the initial service screen of the "Platform" so that users can easily know.

② The "Platform" may amend these Terms within the scope that does not violate relevant laws such as the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce, the Act on Regulation of Terms and Conditions, the Framework Act on Electronic Documents and Electronic Commerce, the Electronic Financial Transaction Act, the Electronic Signature Act, the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, the Door-to-Door Sales Act, and the Framework Act on Consumers.

③ When the "Platform" amends these Terms, the effective date and reasons for amendment shall be specified and announced on the initial screen of the "Platform" from 7 days before the effective date to the day before the effective date, along with the current Terms. However, if the Terms are changed unfavorably to users, at least 30 days' prior notice period shall be given.

Article 4 (Provision and Change of Services)

① The "Platform" performs the following tasks:
• Providing information about services provided to general members
• Providing general member services
• Other tasks determined by the "Platform"

② The "Platform" may change the contents of services to be provided by future contracts in case of changes in technical specifications of services.

Article 5 (Suspension of Services)

① The "Platform" may temporarily suspend the provision of services in case of maintenance, replacement, breakdown of information and communication equipment such as computers, or disconnection of communication.

② The "Platform" shall compensate for damages suffered by users or third parties due to temporary suspension of service provision for reasons in Paragraph 1, if the "Company's" intention or gross negligence is recognized.

Article 6 (Membership Registration)

① Users apply for membership by filling in member information according to the registration form set by the "Platform" and expressing their intention to agree to these Terms.

② The "Platform" registers users who apply for membership as members unless they fall under any of the following:
• If the applicant has previously lost membership qualification under Article 7, Paragraph 3 of these Terms
• If the registration contains false, missing, or erroneous information
• If registration as a member is deemed to significantly impede the "Platform's" technology

Article 7 (Membership Withdrawal and Loss of Qualification)

① Members may request withdrawal from the "Platform" at any time, and the "Platform" processes membership withdrawal after the user's service termination procedure.

② If a member falls under any of the following reasons, the "Platform" may restrict or suspend membership:
• If false information is registered at the time of application
• If debts borne by the member in connection with using the "Platform" are not paid on time
• If the member interferes with others' use of the "Platform" or steals information
• If the member uses the "Platform" to act against laws, these Terms, or public order and morals

Article 8 (Notification to Members)

① When the "Platform" notifies members, it may do so through the email address provided by the member to the "Platform."

② For notifications to unspecified multiple members, the "Platform" may substitute individual notification by posting on the "Platform" bulletin board for at least one week.

Article 9 (Consent to Provide Personal Information)

① When the "Platform" needs to provide user personal information to a third party, it must inform the user and obtain consent regarding who receives the personal information, the purpose of use, items of personal information provided, and the retention and use period.

Article 10 (Supply of Services)

Unless there is a separate agreement with the user regarding the supply period of services, the "Platform" takes necessary measures so that the user can use the services within 7 days from the date of membership registration.

Article 11 (Personal Information Protection)

① The "Platform" collects the minimum personal information necessary for service provision when collecting user personal information.

② The "Platform" does not collect information necessary for purchase contract performance in advance during membership registration.

③ When the "Platform" collects and uses user personal information, it notifies the user of the purpose and obtains consent.

Article 12 (Obligations of the "Platform")

① The "Platform" shall not engage in acts prohibited by laws and these Terms or contrary to public order and morals, and shall do its best to provide services and services continuously and stably as prescribed by these Terms.

② The "Platform" shall have a security system for protecting user personal information (including credit information) so that users can safely use internet services.

Article 13 (Obligations Regarding Member ID and Password)

① The responsibility for managing ID and password rests with the member.

② Members shall not allow third parties to use their ID and password.

③ If a member becomes aware that their ID and password have been stolen or are being used by a third party, they must immediately notify the "Platform" and follow the "Platform's" guidance if any.

Article 14 (User Obligations)

Users shall not engage in the following acts:
• Registering false information when applying or changing
• Stealing others' information
• Changing information posted on the "Platform"
• Transmitting or posting information (computer programs, etc.) other than information set by the "Platform"
• Infringing intellectual property rights such as copyrights of the "Platform" or third parties
• Acts that damage the reputation of the "Platform" or third parties or interfere with their business
• Publicly disclosing or posting obscene or violent messages, images, sounds, or other information contrary to public order and morals on the "Platform"

Article 15 (Relationship Between Linked and Linked Websites)

① When upper and lower websites are connected by hyperlink, the former is called the linking website and the latter is called the linked website.

② The linking website is not responsible for transactions made with users by goods independently provided by the linked website.

Article 16 (Attribution and Restriction of Copyright)

① Copyright and other intellectual property rights for works created by the "Platform" belong to the "Platform."

② Users shall not use information obtained through the "Platform" that belongs to the "Platform's" intellectual property rights for commercial purposes or allow third parties to use it without prior approval of the "Platform."

Article 17 (Dispute Resolution)

① The "Platform" installs and operates a damage compensation processing organization to reflect legitimate opinions or complaints raised by users and to compensate for damages.

② The "Platform" prioritizes processing complaints and opinions submitted by users. However, if prompt processing is difficult, the user is immediately notified of the reason and processing schedule.

Article 18 (Jurisdiction and Governing Law)

① Lawsuits regarding e-commerce disputes between the "Platform" and users shall be under the exclusive jurisdiction of the district court having jurisdiction over the user's address at the time of filing, or residence if there is no address.

② Korean law applies to e-commerce lawsuits filed between the "Platform" and users.

Article 19 (Disclaimer)

① The "Platform" provides paid services for vendor members such as marketing and customer management, and free services for general members. Payment processing, withdrawal of subscription, cancellation, and disputes related to transactions of goods between vendors and members are the responsibility of the individual transaction parties. Therefore, the "Platform" is not involved in transactions between vendors and members and assumes no responsibility.

② Both the "Platform" and members are not responsible for non-compliance with Terms and damages caused by conditions beyond the parties' control, such as force majeure including natural disasters, labor issues, government measures, maintenance, replacement or breakdown of information and communication equipment, internet failures, and denial of service (DoS) attacks.

Supplementary Provisions (Effective Date)

These Terms and Conditions shall be effective from November 1, 2024.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.fullContent:
Yeowubie Interaction Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") processes personal information lawfully and manages it safely in compliance with the Personal Information Protection Act and related laws to protect the freedom and rights of data subjects. In accordance with Article 30 of the Personal Information Protection Act, we establish and disclose this Privacy Policy to guide data subjects on the procedures and standards for processing and protecting personal information, and to handle related complaints promptly and smoothly.

Article 1 (Purpose)

① "Personal information" refers to information about a living individual that can identify the individual through items such as name, resident registration number, etc. contained in the information (including information that cannot identify a specific individual by itself but can be easily combined with other information to identify).

② The Company takes the protection of your personal information very seriously and complies with the personal information protection regulations under the Personal Information Protection Act, the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, and the Personal Information Protection Guidelines established by the Ministry of Information and Communication.

③ The Company makes this Privacy Policy easily accessible to users by posting it on the homepage.

④ The Company has established procedures necessary for revising the Privacy Policy for continuous improvement.

Article 2 (Items and Purposes of Personal Information Collection)

① For Vendor Members

The Company collects minimum personal information for the following purposes:

[Service Provision]
• User identification for service use, individual notification and notice
• Providing vendor information to general member users and vendor member service provision, service purchase

[Service Development and Improvement]
• Service usage record analysis, environment construction for service updates and service improvement

[Personal Information Items Collected]
• Individual: ID, password, name, gender, date of birth, nationality, mobile phone, email, address
• Organization: Business name, business registration number, phone number, email, address, account information, payment information

② For General Members

[Service Provision]
• User identification for service use, individual notification and notice
• User information-based recommendations, vendor benefits, vendor communication and general member service provision

[Service Development and Improvement]
• Service usage record analysis, environment construction for service updates and service improvement

[Personal Information Items Collected]
• General Information: ID, password, name, gender, date of birth, nationality, mobile phone, email, address, location information
• Other: Service usage records, IP address, terminal information (OS, device identifier)

You have the right to refuse consent to the collection and use of personal information, and refusal of consent may restrict membership registration or prevent service use.

Article 3 (Protection of Children's Personal Information)

The Company restricts membership registration for children under 14 years of age who require the consent of a legal representative and does not collect or use any personal information.

Article 4 (Retention and Use Period of Collected Personal Information)

① The Company's principle is to destroy personal information without delay when the purpose of collection and provision is achieved. However, if retention is required by relevant laws, it will be retained for that period.

• Records on contracts or subscription withdrawal: 5 years (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)
• Records on payment and supply of goods: 5 years (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)
• Records on consumer complaints or dispute handling: 3 years (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)
• Log records: 3 months (Protection of Communications Secrets Act)

Article 5 (Procedures and Methods for Destruction of Personal Information)

① The Company destroys personal information without delay when it becomes unnecessary due to the expiration of the retention and use period or achievement of processing purpose.

② Procedures and methods for destruction of personal information:
• Destruction procedure: Collected personal information is moved to a separate database or stored in a different location according to internal policies and relevant laws, then destroyed.
• Destruction method: Personal information recorded and stored in electronic file format is destroyed using technical or physical methods that prevent reproduction, and personal information recorded and stored in paper documents is destroyed by shredding or incineration.

Article 6 (Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties)

① The Company does not use user personal information beyond the scope notified in Article 2 or provide it to others or other companies or institutions. However, exceptions are as follows:
• When requested by relevant authorities for investigative purposes under relevant laws
• When provided in a form that cannot identify specific individuals for statistics, academic research, or market research
• When requested according to procedures prescribed by other relevant laws

② The Company provides personal information to third parties as follows only when users have consented in advance for smooth service use:
• Recipients of personal information: Winnie Platform vendor members (affiliated stores)
• Purpose of use by recipients: Provision of vendor products and services and history management, consultation response and event benefit provision
• Personal information items provided: Name and ID for member matching and identification / Gender, nationality, date of birth, phone number, email, address for service and benefit provision
• Retention and use period by recipients: Until user withdrawal or withdrawal of service use consent

Article 7 (Measures to Ensure Safety of Personal Information)

① Administrative measures: Establishment and implementation of internal management plan, operation of dedicated organization, regular employee training
② Technical measures: Management of access rights to personal information processing systems, installation of access control systems, encryption of personal information, installation and update of security programs
③ Physical measures: Access control to computer rooms, data storage rooms, etc.

Article 8 (Rights, Obligations, and Exercise Methods of Users and Legal Representatives)

① Users may exercise the following personal information protection related rights at any time as data subjects:
• Request for access to personal information
• Request for correction if there are errors
• Request for deletion
• Request for suspension of processing
• Membership withdrawal (withdrawal of personal information consent)

② The Company may refuse access/correction/deletion of all or part of personal information in the following cases:
• When access is prohibited or restricted by law
• When the personal information is specified as a collection target in other laws
• When there is a risk of harming the life or body of others or unfairly infringing on the property and other interests of others

Article 9 (User Rights and Obligations)

① Please enter your personal information accurately and up-to-date to prevent unexpected accidents. The responsibility for accidents caused by inaccurate information entered by users lies with the users themselves, and membership may be revoked if false information such as identity theft is entered.

② Users have the right to have their personal information protected and also have the obligation to protect themselves and not infringe on others' information.

Article 10 (Personal Information Protection Officer)

The Company designates a personal information protection officer as follows to take overall responsibility for personal information processing and handle complaints and damage relief of data subjects related to personal information processing.

• Personal Information Protection Department: Winnie Operations Team
• Name: Hawon Kim
• Email: winnie@yeowubie.com

Article 11 (Remedies for Rights Infringement)

Data subjects may apply for dispute resolution or consultation with the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee, Korea Internet & Security Agency Personal Information Infringement Report Center, etc. to receive relief from personal information infringement.

• Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: (no area code) 1833-6972 (www.kopico.go.kr)
• Personal Information Infringement Report Center: (no area code) 118 (privacy.kisa.or.kr)
• Supreme Prosecutors' Office: (no area code) 1301 (www.spo.go.kr)
• National Police Agency: (no area code) 182 (ecrm.cyber.go.kr)

Article 12 (Changes to Privacy Policy)

This Privacy Policy shall be effective from November 1, 2024.
